access.edition_or_version: Penguin Books India, translated by Aatish Taseer (stories written 1930s-1950s)

mechanics.point_of_view: Third-person and first-person sketches that stay external and report events plainly.
mechanics.style_and_devices: Clinical declaratives; procedural cadence; ellipsis; flat final sentences that return to routine after atrocity; buried charge in a single act or object.
mechanics.emotional_progression: Affect is withheld at the moment of maximum violence; moral pressure is generated by the gap between event and register rather than by commentary.
mechanics.dialogue: Clipped, transactional speech that carries class and occupation; no authorial lament.
mechanics.verification_note: Technique independently attested in the repository genre file genres/satirical-literature.md Ch.07; translation limits recorded in the source record.
